reviewPassage:
Volunteer circular | Reedbank Kite Day

Flyers can decorate their own kites, and spectators can practice with a loan kite in the small field. For the afternoon parade, the large field is reserved for kites with streamer tails. A tail does not need to match the color of its kite, but it must be long enough for the parade steward to see from the fence.

Some families drop off an undecorated kite at the craft tent and come back to add a tail. Do not send one of those kites to the parade line until the family has chosen and tied on a tail that the steward can see.

Wet streamer tails are laid flat on the grass behind the craft tent. Volunteers attach a small matching claim tag to the kite and to the spot where its tail is drying. When you move a tail to another drying spot, move its tag to that new spot as well. The two tags tell you which tail goes with which kite, even when neighboring streamers happen to look alike.

In the practice field, loan kites have fixed short tails and are identified by white handles. These are not parade kites. Visitors can take one for fifteen minutes. A new loan may begin once the previous return has been recorded in the steward’s register; the queue order does not change.

If a family leaves before collecting an owned kite, take it inside the center at dusk. It will be kept there on a temporary basis; any kite still there at noon on Sunday goes to the main lost-property desk.

志工通知｜蘆岸風箏日

放風箏的人可以自行裝飾風箏，觀眾則可以在小草地借風箏練習。下午遊行時，大草地只供裝了彩帶尾帶的風箏使用。尾帶不須和風箏同色，但必須夠長，讓遊行引導員從圍欄邊就看得到。

有些家庭會先把未裝飾的風箏留在手作帳篷，之後再回來裝尾帶。等家人選好並繫上引導員看得見的尾帶，再把風箏送去遊行排隊區。

潮濕的彩帶尾帶會攤平在手作帳篷後面的草地上晾乾。志工會在風箏上和尾帶晾乾的位置各貼一張相符的認領標籤。若把尾帶移到另一處晾乾，也把它的認領標籤移到新位置。 即使相鄰的彩帶看起來一樣，這兩張標籤也能指出哪條尾帶屬於哪具風箏。

練習場的借用風箏有固定的短尾帶，並以白色手把辨認。這些不是遊行風箏。訪客可以借用十五分鐘。上一次歸還已登記在引導員的登記簿後，即可開始下一次出借；現場排隊順序不變。

若有家庭未取回自有的風箏就先離開，黃昏時請把風箏移到中心室內。中心只會暫時保管；星期日中午還在該處的風箏會送去總失物招領處。
